name: Ryan Hadi
headline: Business Development Manager | B2B SaaS Sales, Indonesia
summary: SaaS closer with 5+ years in quota-carrying B2B roles and a native Bahasa speaker. Closed eight new-logo enterprise deals worth IDR 10B+ (~USD 550K) TCV at 115%+ of 2025 quota, qualifying every deal with MEDDICC and selling on value and ROI to buying committees from department heads to C-suite. Uses AI tools as a core part of the sales motion. Ready to sell into hotels, chains, and hospitality groups.

experience.title: Business Development Manager, B2B Partnerships
experience.about: Sinar Mas Land's enterprise technology unit (PT Samakta Mitra) selling B2B SaaS, cloud, managed services, and smart city solutions to 110+ external corporate clients.
bullets: Closed eight new-logo enterprise deals (March 2023 to present) totaling IDR 10B+ (~USD 550K) TCV, average deal size IDR 1.25B, selling SaaS, smart CCTV, and network solutions to technology and AI companies and renewable energy operators; 100%+ average quota attainment, 115%+ in 2025.

Ran full-cycle new business across SMB and enterprise accounts: worked inbound and outbound leads against a territory and target-account plan, ran tailored demos for C-level, VP, and department-head buyers, set deal pricing and packages, and kept forecasts and pipeline reporting accurate in CRM.
Sold SaaS on recurring subscription contracts, with recurring fees worth 25%+ of contract value per year on top of implementation; qualified every opportunity with MEDDICC.

Built LLM-based sales workflows (ChatGPT, Claude) that tripled account research volume, doubled discovery calls booked, and cut proposal turnaround from multiple days to one day, saving 10+ hours a week.
Shortened sales cycle (proposal to signature) 20%, from 60 to 48 days, by running deal-desk style parallel reviews with Legal, Finance, and Operations.

Grew partner-sourced pipeline 25% (IDR 2B to IDR 2.5B, ~USD 140K) in 12 months, including partner referrals, by running QBRs, partner enablement and training, and joint go-to-market plans with 20 active channel partners; recruited and onboarded four new partners.

experience.title: Business Development Executive

bullets: Hit 120%+ of new-business quota, contributing to 12 new logos and IDR 750M in first-year revenue.

Managed a recurring corporate-contract book covering 1,500 employees across 12 clients: renewed 10 of 12 (83% logo retention) and generated IDR 150M in expansion revenue.
Built outbound pipeline in HubSpot CRM targeting HR and procurement buyers, generating 20 qualified leads and 10 discovery calls per month.

leadership.text: Led four events with 200+ attendees each, coordinating internal teams and external partners.
